_comment: Fixed lines the agent says on every call. These are rendered once by `pnpm --filter @msva/telephony render:prompts` and played from disk, so they cost nothing per call and add no synthesis latency. The `text` must match EXACTLY what the code speaks — if you change CALL_GREETING or a line below, re-run the render script or the line quietly falls back to live synthesis.

prompts.text: Namaste! Madhusudan family se baat ho rahi hai. Main aapki AI assistant hoon. Bataiye, milk, ghee, paneer, dahi ya kisi order ke baare mein kaise madad karun?
prompts.usedFor: Spoken on every inbound call before the caller says anything.

prompts.text: Ek minute, main check kar raha hoon.
Main aapko abhi hamari team se jod raha hoon. Kripya line par rahiye.
prompts.usedFor: Spoken immediately before a warm transfer to a human.

prompts.text: Maaf kijiye, main theek se samajh nahi paya. Kripya dobara bataiye.
Madhusudan family se baat karne ke liye dhanyavaad. Aapka din shubh ho.
prompts.usedFor: Sign-off at the end of a call.

prompts.text: Namaste, Madhusudan family se baat ho rahi hai. Aapke order ki jaankari ke liye dhanyavaad. Main aapki request register kar raha hoon aur hamari team aapse jald hi sampark karegi.
prompts.usedFor: Scripted line that keeps the line alive if the live pipeline is unreachable.
